proof_body:
by
  intro A _ a b n ha
  have hl : (LinearMap.mulLeft ℤ a) ^ (n + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [LinearMap.pow_mulLeft, ha, LinearMap.mulLeft_zero_eq_zero]
  have hr : (-LinearMap.mulRight ℤ a) ^ (n + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [neg_pow, LinearMap.pow_mulRight, ha, LinearMap.mulRight_zero_eq_zero, mul_zero]
  have hc : Commute (LinearMap.mulLeft ℤ a) (-LinearMap.mulRight ℤ a) := (LinearMap.commute_mulLeft_right a a).neg_right
  have h := hc.add_pow_eq_zero_of_add_le_succ_of_pow_eq_zero hl hr (k := 2 * n + 1) (by omega)
  have e : (fun x => a * x - x * a) = ⇑(LinearMap.mulLeft ℤ a + -LinearMap.mulRight ℤ a) := by
    ext x
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [e, ← Module.End.pow_apply, h, LinearMap.zero_apply]
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [Ring A] (a b : A) (n : ℕ), a ^ (n + 1) = 0 → (fun x => a * x - x * a)^[2 * n + 1] b = 0
